text.9:120: It is not for the townsfolk of Al-Madinah and for those around them of the wandering Arabs so stay behind the messenger of Allah and prefer their lives to his life. That is because neither thirst nor toil nor hunger afflicteth them in the way of Allah, nor step they any step that angereth the disbelievers, nor gain they from the enemy a gain, but a good deed is recorded for them therefor. Lo! Allah loseth not the wages of the good.
text.15:48: Toil cometh not unto them there, nor will they be expelled from thence.
text.18:62: And when they had gone further, he said unto his servant: Bring us our breakfast. Verily we have found fatigue in this our journey.
text.35:35: Who, of His grace, hath installed us in the mansion of eternity, where toil toucheth us not nor can weariness affect us.
